description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET Api/Products/Subscriptions/Get. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Lists the HGR listing-subscription plans and prices available to the requesting account. ownerAgent: account-metrics. supportingAgents: support, orchestrator. Domain: account_metrics. Entity: subscription_plan. Operation: list. Scope: product_catalog. AllowedIntents: subscription_plan_catalog. Use when: Use to quote monthly or annual plan prices and compare listing capacities. Input: No body or query input. Authentication is optional: sign in for eligible legacy prices. Anonymous requests receive public prices. Admin-only: false. The selected channel is not required. Output: Returns the complete enabled listing-plan catalogue. ProductOrder is listing capacity. Each price includes PlatformId, BillingPeriodId, CurrencyId, Price and PlatformProductId. LegacyPricing indicates continuing legacy subscription eligibility. Search terms: products subscriptions get.
name: hgr_get_products_subscriptions_get
title: Get Products Subscriptions Get
